title: The Lost Bell
summary: A smart owl finds a lost bell in the forest using blends and FLOSS words.

pages.text: A brown owl went into the forest.
pages.scene: A wise owl flying through tall trees at dusk

pages.text: The owl heard a soft sound and stopped.
pages.scene: Owl tilting head, listening to distant ringing

pages.text: A bell was stuck on a stump.
pages.scene: A brass bell tangled in tree roots

pages.text: The owl felt the bell and rang it.
pages.scene: Owl using talon to tap the bell gently

pages.text: It will not come off the stump.
pages.scene: Bell firmly stuck despite the owl's attempts

pages.text: A swift fox ran past the owl.
pages.scene: Reddish fox trotting quickly through underbrush

pages.text: Will you help me find the bell?
pages.scene: Owl and fox standing together, cooperating

pages.text: We can push and pull it off.
pages.scene: Both animals working together to free the bell

pages.text: The bell went off with a rang and bang!
pages.scene: Bell suddenly loosening, making a loud sound

pages.text: We felt so glad about the bell.
pages.scene: Owl and fox celebrating their success

pages.text: The bell will stay with us at last.
pages.scene: Bell displayed proudly in their forest home
Owl and fox friends, with bell in background
